scope: Complete source-only read of both v1 and both v2 scripts plus preparation and root review JSON records.
status: Four concrete source findings; v2 remains unexecuted and unselected.

findings.title: Audit destination can replace the source or finished archive
findings.evidence: Only source/output equality is rejected. args.audit is passed to atomic_write after source-integrity verification and after installing the output. Assigning the audit path to source or output replaces that archive with audit JSON.
findings.bounded_suggestion: Resolve and validate audit at v2 preflight; reject equality with source/output and require a new audit path to protect existing frozen files. Leave v1 unchanged unless separately directed.
findings.observed_checkpoint_impact: None asserted. Root states checkpoint25 used distinct source/output/audit paths.

findings.title: Original paths accepted by the source can collide during tree restoration
findings.evidence: Raw names a.bin and ./a.bin both map to parts (a.bin) and the same target; the second replacement overwrites the first. Entry order a.bin.restore-part then a.bin makes the latter's fixed temporary path equal an existing restored original and its exclusive open fail. Per-entry in-memory byte verification does not exercise these filesystem mappings.
findings.bounded_suggestion: Preflight the exact original-name-to-target mapping and reject collisions before packaging/restoration; allocate exclusive temporary paths reserved away from every original target.
findings.observed_checkpoint_impact: None asserted. No checkpoint entries were inspected.

findings.title: Non-object parsed cache metadata skips fresh encoding
findings.evidence: JSON null parses as None and metadata.get raises AttributeError outside the inner OSError/ValueError/KeyError handler. The outer codec handler then skips the remaining cache location and fresh encoder for that codec.
findings.exactness_effect: Original storage or another exact-checked candidate remains available; this finding concerns incomplete cache-miss recovery and candidate availability.
findings.bounded_suggestion: Require isinstance(metadata, dict) before field lookup and treat all other JSON result types as invalid cache records, continuing lookup or fresh encoding.
findings.observed_checkpoint_impact: None asserted. No cache payload or codec was executed.

findings.title: Repeated executions of the same snapshot reuse the statement ID
findings.evidence: statement_id depends only on source_digest and the constant MIXED-JXL7 variant suffix. Every invocation over the same snapshot therefore generates the same ID, while completion dates belong to separate executions.
findings.bounded_suggestion: Add a per-run identifier to the v2 event ID and record it in the audit, retaining source digest and codec variant.
findings.observed_checkpoint_impact: None asserted. No completed v2 event exists within this review.

selection_gate: V2 remains unexecuted and unselected until a completed later v1 transport actually exceeds the cap.
result_limits: No compression ratio, performance, codec equality, manuscript, mathematical, or ink result is claimed.
